snippet.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalker Longplay (Arcade) [60 FPS]
snippet.description:
Follow me on Twitter @ https://twitter.com/Al82_Retro
Developed and published by Sega in 1990

Another classic Sega arcade release that happens to be a collaboration with the King of Pop himself.

In gameplay terms the concept is sound enough, but the isometric perspective makes it a lot harder to hit enemies than you might think.

Added to the fact that many of the later enemies are total damage sponges, it ends up being far less enjoyable than I'd hoped.

#michaeljackson
#moonwalker
#retrogaming
